summary: Iteration 6 backend-only smoke regression after adding dnspython==2.6.1 to /app/backend/requirements.txt (no Python/JS code change). Full existing suite /app/backend/tests/test_dinho_api.py: 11/11 PASSED in 4.4s against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Covered: /api/health ok + database connected, admin login 200 (admin@dinhorodas.com/Dinho#2026) and 401 with JSON detail, invalid-token guard, quote multipart submit with photo + byte-for-byte /api/files/{id} retrieval + persistence, unknown file 404, invalid admin collection 404, admin services CRUD, dashboard metrics auth+shape, /api/public payload shape. Dependency check: `pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed -r requirements.txt` resolves cleanly with no conflicts; dnspython-2.6.1 installs as a pure-python wheel and pydantic_core 2.16.3 still resolves to a prebuilt cp311 manylinux wheel (no source build). Verified dnspython is actually wired into pymongo: parse_uri('mongodb+srv://...') now performs a real SRV DNS lookup and returns pymongo ConfigurationError 'The DNS query name does not exist' instead of failing on a missing dnspython dependency - so mongodb+srv:// URIs will be resolvable on Render. Backend supervisor logs show only expected 200/401/404 lines, no tracebacks. No regression detected.

minor.issue: Carried over from iteration 5: render.yaml uses rootDir: backend but .python-version lives at repo root, so it is dead config for the service (runtime.txt + PYTHON_VERSION env are the effective ones). Harmless, values agree on 3.11.9.

action_items: No code action needed. The Render failure (TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR during SSL handshake) is an Atlas Network Access config issue: add 0.0.0.0/0 (or Render static outbound IPs) to the Atlas IP allowlist; Atlas aborts the TLS handshake for non-allowlisted IPs before authentication, which surfaces exactly as this pymongo ServerSelectionTimeoutError.
critical_code_review_comments: dnspython==2.6.1 is compatible with pymongo 4.6.3 (requires dnspython>=1.16,<3.0) - pin is safe. Confirmed SRV resolution path is live.

Still open from earlier iterations: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (migrate to lifespan); admin routing does not push URL state; frontend/public/index.html still has the Emergent template title/meta.
seed_data_creation: pytest-created TEST_ quote/service records self-cleaned via existing fixtures; one leftover UI quote 'TEST_QA Iter5' from iteration 5 remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_dinho_api.py -v` (11 tests, xdist, pytest.ini at /app/backend). Deploy sanity: `cd /app/backend && pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed -r requirements.txt` and confirm pydantic_core downloads a cp311 wheel. requirements now includes dnspython==2.6.1 for mongodb+srv support. Remaining Render blocker is Atlas IP allowlist, not code.
rca_of_the_issue: Render deploy error 'SSL handshake failed: TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR' from MongoDB Atlas is emitted when the connecting IP is not in the Atlas Network Access allowlist - Atlas terminates TLS before auth, so pymongo reports ServerSelectionTimeoutError. dnspython==2.6.1 was added because pymongo requires it to resolve mongodb+srv:// SRV records; verified locally that SRV lookups now execute. Neither change affects application behaviour; all 11 backend tests remain green.
